title: Typed DXF OBJECTS record-name retained-budget fast slice
mode: Local parser accounting implementation with generated fast validation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Audit OBJECTS typed projections that retain the source record name separately from their raw carrier.
Charge dynamic-block and AcSh-history record names before copying them into callback-owned typed objects.
Verify exact retained-byte admission, one-byte-under refusal, and independent raw/typed lease release with scratch-generated ASCII controls.

changes.implementation: processDynamicBlockObject and processAcShHistoryObject now default-construct their typed values, charge nextentity.size() to m_dxfRetainedStringLease before assigning m_recordName, then publish. Dynamic-block kind classification follows the admitted name assignment. Admission or allocation failures return BAD_CODE_PARSED before callbacks.
changes.sourceAudit: The adjacent associative-object constructor-time record-name gap was fixed in the preceding slice. The audited typed OBJECTS constructors that duplicate nextentity into m_recordName are now associative, dynamic-block, and AcSh-history paths. This receipt covers the latter two; generic typed/raw processors without a retained record-name member were not mass-rewritten.
changes.generatedTest: The focused selector constructs BLOCKVISIBILITYPARAMETER and ACSH_HISTORY_NODE OBJECTS records in memory. For each it finds the minimum successful budget, checks the aggregate raw carrier plus typed-name lease, releases raw callback storage and confirms the typed name remains charged, then releases the typed value and confirms zero charge. One byte below the threshold must produce ResourceLimit/dxf-retained-byte-budget before typed or raw callback publication.

nonClaims: The parser lease accounts logical retained string bytes for these destinations, not allocator capacity or RSS.
The slice does not account every duplicate callback/output copy in the parser operation lease and does not complete the 7S.2c retained-output census.
No DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
The shared worktree is extensively dirty; no staging or commit occurred.
